tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background: a soft neutral grey with no tint, so every theme sits on it. Cards sit on it. Text uses ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped lists, inputs and sheets. Lifted from bg by shadow-1 in light and by its lighter value in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs. Pair with shadow-2.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Track of a segmented control, wells, icon tiles with no tint.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Neutral hover and highlight fill: a hovered IconButton, Select field or list row, the pointer's highlight in a Menu or a Select's list. At least 1.3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both modes. Never selection, never the only signal.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside grouped lists. Decorative; cards themselves have no border.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and unchecked switches. Meets 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and placeholders on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The theme colour, kiwi green by default: primary buttons, links, switches that are on, the current place. Replaced by the chosen theme.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. Replaced by the chosen theme.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons, the current tab's pill, selected rows, tinted icon tiles. Replaced by the chosen theme.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The kiwi green, fixed in every theme: the dot beside the host's status and brand artwork. Never a control colour.

tokens.name: kiwi-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind avatars and placeholder artwork.

tokens.name: skin
tokens.usage: The kiwi's brown. Illustration only.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Soft relief inside illustrations.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground behind the ink logo mark. Light in both themes because the mark's ink is fixed dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy and completed states. Text on bg, surface or success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a success status chip or icon tile.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention. Text on bg, surface or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a warning status chip or icon tile.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Fill of the danger button; text on bg, surface or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a danger status chip.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on danger.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational notices. Text on bg, surface or info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of an info status chip or icon tile.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px with a 2px offset. A warm colour so it stays visible beside every theme's accent.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of floating bars over a blur-glass backdrop blur: 82% (light) and 84% (dark), so secondary text on a bar stays 4.5:1 over anything scrolled beneath (the contrast audit, 2026-10-23; it was 72%).

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: 1px edge highlight on floating bars.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: data-red
tokens.usage: Red in the palette for calendars myData owns (ColourPicker). A data colour: one value in both modes, drawn as given with DataColour's edge rule, never a control colour or a fill behind text. Not replaced by a theme.

tokens.usage: Brown in the palette for calendars myData owns (ColourPicker). A data colour: one value in both modes, drawn as given with DataColour's edge rule, never a control colour or a fill behind text. Not replaced by a theme.

tokens.name: data-grey
tokens.usage: Grey in the palette for calendars myData owns (ColourPicker). A data colour: one value in both modes, drawn as given with DataColour's edge rule, never a control colour or a fill behind text. Not replaced by a theme.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: First-run headlines and the large title at the top of a phone screen.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles on desktop; the figure in a stat tile.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles that lead a screen, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text on desktop. Phones use 16px.
styles.sample: Each app works by itself and reads the data your host keeps.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines, helper text, metadata. Use ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and the small heading above a grouped list. Sentence case, not uppercase.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Paths, addresses and values the user copies.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon tile and its text; gap between cards in a tight grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding; side gutter on phone; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between major groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: First-run and empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top inset on phone screens without a bar.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: The checkbox's box.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Photo tiles, icon tiles, small wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped lists.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs and floating bars.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, segmented controls, switches, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and grouped lists on bg. This soft lift replaces borders.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Floating bars.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind glass-fill. Becomes 0, with a surface fill, when the user reduces transparency.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips and the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-height-compact
tokens.usage: Desktop-only compact density.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Rows in a grouped list.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: The rounded tile behind a row's icon.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default icon box. Icons use a 1.75px rounded stroke.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of reading and settings columns.

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Width of a Dialog's panel, or the window less space-8 on each side when that is narrower.

tokens.name: inspector-width
tokens.usage: Width of an Inspector at the end edge of the window.

macos.usage: The Mac shell (docs/2026-10-23-plan.md section 5, "native frame, quiet brand"): the system font, Mac density and the system's colours, used by every app in a macOS build (MacLook in mydata_ui). The colours are fallbacks: on a Mac the app reads the system's own (NSColor, the accent included) over the `mydata/system_colors` channel, so these values show only in tests, in screenshots made without a Mac and when the channel is missing. They are the system defaults (blue accent).
macos.familyUsage: text: the system font as Flutter's macOS engine names it (SF Pro through CoreText). display: the same system font for 20px and up, where CoreText switches to SF Pro Display's optical size by itself (Flutter's `CupertinoSystemDisplay` name is documented for iOS; whether macOS resolves it is unverified). icons: Lucide (ISC), subset and bundled in mydata_ui, in place of SF Symbols, which may only be used through Apple's own frameworks.

color.name: accent
color.usage: The system's accent colour (controlAccentColor) when it cannot be read: macOS's default blue. Selection in a focused list, the default button, links, sidebar icons.

color.name: on-accent
color.usage: Text and icons on accent: a selected row in a focused list.

color.name: secondary-label
color.usage: Secondary text: a field's label, a count, a source line (secondaryLabelColor).

color.name: quaternary-label
color.usage: The faintest fill: a search field's ground (quaternaryLabelColor).

color.name: separator
color.usage: Hairlines between columns and under the toolbar (separatorColor).

color.name: content-background
color.usage: Behind lists and the record they open (controlBackgroundColor).

color.name: window-background
color.usage: Behind everything else in a window (windowBackgroundColor).

color.name: sidebar-background
color.usage: The sidebar where it cannot be translucent: reduced transparency, tests and screenshots.

color.name: selection-inactive
color.usage: A selected row while its list does not have focus (unemphasizedSelectedContentBackgroundColor).

color.name: sidebar-selection
color.usage: The selected row of a sidebar: a neutral fill under its accent icon.

color.name: hover
color.usage: Under the pointer on a toolbar item or a borderless button.

color.name: focus-ring
color.usage: The keyboard focus ring (keyboardFocusIndicatorColor, which follows the system's accent) on every control in the Mac frame, a field in error included: the branded red `focus` ring and its `ink` rule are not used on a Mac.

color.name: red
color.usage: The system's red (systemRed): today's date in myCalendar, as Calendar.app marks it.

color.name: green
color.usage: The system's green (systemGreen): the round add button in an editing form, as Contacts' edit mode draws it.

color.name: toolbar-item
color.usage: The flat stand-in for a toolbar item's Liquid Glass (Flutter cannot draw glass): with a 0.5 pt `separator` outline.

type.name: body
type.usage: Default text: list rows, values on a record (macOS body).

type.name: body-emphasized
type.usage: The sorting name in a list row, a toolbar title on its own (macOS body, emphasized).

type.name: callout
type.usage: A field's label on a record, a button's smaller text.

type.name: caption
type.usage: Counts, a source line, the sidebar's connection line.

type.name: caption-emphasized
type.usage: A list's section letters and a sidebar's headings.

type.name: action
type.usage: The caption under a round quick action (message, call, mail).

type.name: title
type.usage: A toolbar title: the section shown.

type.name: pane-title
type.usage: A pane's title, one per pane: a record's name, "Merge 2 contacts?", "New Contact", a month in myCalendar, a page of myData. The second of the three title roles (toolbar `title`, `pane-title`, `section-header`).

type.name: section-header
type.usage: A section's heading inside a pane (a Settings group, "After merging", a list's group). The third title role.

type.name: name
type.usage: A record's name at the top of its page.

type.name: avatar
type.usage: Initials in a record's large avatar.

size.name: toolbar-height
size.usage: The unified toolbar: the title bar and the toolbar in one band.

size.name: sidebar-width
size.usage: The sidebar column: the floating panel (`sidebar-margin` in from the window's left, top and bottom edges) with the app's sections. 208 is SwiftUI's default on macOS 26 (a 200 pt panel 8 pt in).

size.name: list-width
size.usage: The list column beside the record it opens.

size.name: row-height
size.usage: A row in a plain list: about 30 in an 800pt window.

size.name: section-height
size.usage: A list's section heading (its letter).

size.name: sidebar-row-height
size.usage: A sidebar row (macOS 26: 32 pt, as SwiftUI's sidebar).

size.name: control-height
size.usage: Toolbar items and the search field.

size.name: push-button-height
size.usage: A push button (Restore, Retry, a dialog's buttons) in the Mac frame: a capsule with the label in `body`.

size.name: control-min
size.usage: The smallest target: a push button in a dense row.

size.name: search-width
size.usage: The toolbar's search field (as SwiftUI's `.searchable` in the toolbar on macOS 26).

size.name: icon
size.usage: Icons in the sidebar, the toolbar and buttons.

size.name: avatar
size.usage: The avatar at the top of a record's page.

size.name: action-button
size.usage: A round quick action under a record's name.

size.name: label-column
size.usage: The labels' column on a record's page, right-aligned.

size.name: row-inset
size.usage: Between a list's side and its selection fill.

size.name: row-padding
size.usage: Between the selection fill's side and the row's text.

size.name: toolbar-item-height
size.usage: A toolbar item's capsule or circle (macOS 26 toolbar items, 36 pt).

size.name: toolbar-inset
size.usage: From the column's edges to the first and last toolbar items.

size.name: window-controls-width
size.usage: The room the window's close, minimise and zoom buttons take at the toolbar band's leading edge when no sidebar is beside the pane (a window showing one state, such as no source yet).

size.name: sidebar-margin
size.usage: The floating sidebar panel's gap to the window's left, top and bottom edges (macOS 26).

size.name: focus-ring-width
size.usage: The keyboard focus ring's width in the Mac frame (the system's is about 3 pt; check it against a live window).

size.name: focus-ring-offset
size.usage: The gap between a control and its focus ring in the Mac frame: none, the ring hugs the control as the system's does.

size.name: hairline
size.usage: A hairline: a group's outline, a toolbar item's edge, a switch thumb's edge (one pixel on a Retina screen).

size.name: tight
size.usage: The smallest gap: between a title and the line under it, inside a segmented control, a field's text from its bezel.

size.name: content-width
size.usage: A detail pane's readable column (a record's page, the editor, Merge, Review), leading-aligned; and a Settings-style form's column, centred.

size.name: alert-width
size.usage: An alert's panel: macOS 26 alerts are narrow, their text wrapping (NSAlert is about 260 pt plus its margins).

size.name: list-min-width
size.usage: A list column beside a record, at its narrowest.

size.name: list-max-width
size.usage: A list column beside a record, at its widest.

size.name: side-list-width
size.usage: A day's or an item's list beside a grid (myCalendar's day list).

size.name: beside-min-width
size.usage: The narrowest content beside which a side list still fits; narrower, the side list goes under it.

size.name: grid-time-cell-width
size.usage: A month grid's cell at least this wide shows each event's start time.

radius.name: selection
radius.usage: A selected list row, and a run of them.

radius.name: control
radius.usage: Toolbar items and borderless buttons under the pointer.

radius.name: field
radius.usage: The toolbar's search field: a capsule.
